=== FILE: tb/test_crc8_block.py ===
"""cocotb tests for crc8_block, written from interface_spec.md (not from the RTL).

Spec summary used for the model:
  start value 0xFF; polynomial 0x07; bits of each byte taken from bit 7 to
  bit 0, no reflection; crc = running value XOR 0xFF, combinational;
  reset (sync, active low) and init both reload 0xFF; init wins over valid;
  with valid low and init low the running value holds.
"""

import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import FallingEdge, ReadOnly, RisingEdge

START = 0xFF
POLY = 0x07
XOR_OUT = 0xFF


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference models, from the specification text
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def model_take_byte_bitwise(running, byte):
    """Section 2.2 as worded: for each bit 7..0, XOR the bit into the top bit
    of the running value, shift left one place, and if the bit shifted out was
    1, XOR the result with the polynomial."""
    r = running & 0xFF
    for i in range(7, -1, -1):
        bit = (byte >> i) & 1
        r ^= bit << 7
        out = (r >> 7) & 1
        r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
        if out:
            r ^= POLY
    return r


def model_take_byte_bytewise(running, byte):
    """Equivalent textbook form of a non-reflected CRC: XOR the whole byte into
    the register, then shift eight times, reducing by the polynomial."""
    r = (running ^ byte) & 0xFF
    for _ in range(8):
        if r & 0x80:
            r = ((r << 1) ^ POLY) & 0xFF
        else:
            r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
    return r


def model_take_byte(running, byte):
    a = model_take_byte_bitwise(running, byte)
    b = model_take_byte_bytewise(running, byte)
    assert a == b, (
        f"reference models disagree: running=0x{running:02x} byte=0x{byte:02x} "
        f"bitwise=0x{a:02x} bytewise=0x{b:02x}"
    )
    return a


def model_crc_of(frame):
    r = START
    for byte in frame:
        r = model_take_byte(r, byte)
    return r ^ XOR_OUT


class Model:
    def __init__(self):
        self.running = None  # unknown until the first reset edge

    def edge(self, rst_n, init, valid, data):
        if not rst_n:
            self.running = START            # CRC-RESET
        elif init:
            self.running = START            # CRC-INIT, wins over valid
        elif valid:
            self.running = model_take_byte(self.running, data)  # CRC-POLY/ORDER
        # else: hold                          CRC-HOLD

    @property
    def crc(self):
        return self.running ^ XOR_OUT        # CRC-FINAL


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Harness
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Harness:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.model = Model()
        self.checks = 0

    async def start(self):
        cocotb.start_soon(Clock(self.dut.clk, 10, "ns").start())
        await self.drive(rst_n=0, init=0, valid=0, data=0)

    async def drive(self, rst_n=1, init=0, valid=0, data=0, tag=""):
        """Drive inputs after the falling edge, then check crc after the next
        rising edge, once the design has settled."""
        await FallingEdge(self.dut.clk)
        if self.model.running is not None:
            # crc is combinational and must be stable between edges (CRC-FINAL)
            self.check(tag + " [between edges]")
        self.dut.rst_n.value = rst_n
        self.dut.init.value = init
        self.dut.valid.value = valid
        self.dut.data.value = data
        await RisingEdge(self.dut.clk)
        await ReadOnly()
        self.model.edge(rst_n, init, valid, data)
        self.check(
            f"{tag} rst_n={rst_n} init={init} valid={valid} data=0x{data:02x}"
        )

    def check(self, ctx):
        got = self.dut.crc.value
        assert got.is_resolvable, f"crc has X/Z ({got}) {ctx}"
        got = int(got)
        exp = self.model.crc
        assert got == exp, f"crc mismatch: got 0x{got:02x} expected 0x{exp:02x} {ctx}"
        self.checks += 1

    async def reset(self, cycles=3):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            await self.drive(rst_n=0, init=0, valid=0, data=0, tag="reset")

    async def frame(self, data_bytes, tag="frame"):
        await self.drive(init=1, tag=tag + " init")
        for b in data_bytes:
            await self.drive(valid=1, data=b, tag=tag)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@cocotb.test(timeout_time=200, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_model_self_consistency(dut):
    """The two spec formulations agree on every (running, byte) pair, and the
    reset value gives crc 0x00. Also exercises the DUT through reset."""
    for r in range(256):
        for b in range(256):
            model_take_byte(r, b)
    assert START ^ XOR_OUT == 0x00
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    assert h.checks > 0


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=200, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_and_empty(dut):
    """CRC-RESET, CRC-EMPTY: after reset crc is 0x00; reset beats valid and init."""
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "CRC-EMPTY after reset"
    # take a byte so the value moves away from empty
    await h.drive(valid=1, data=0xA5, tag="CRC-RESET pre")
    assert int(dut.crc.value) != 0x00 or model_crc_of([0xA5]) == 0x00
    # reset with valid high and a byte offered: reset must win
    await h.drive(rst_n=0, valid=1, data=0x3C, tag="CRC-RESET with valid")
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "reset did not reload 0xFF"
    await h.drive(valid=1, data=0x12, tag="CRC-RESET after")
    await h.drive(rst_n=0, init=1, valid=1, data=0x77, tag="CRC-RESET with init")
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=200, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_init_priority(dut):
    """CRC-INIT: init reloads 0xFF whatever valid and data hold."""
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    for b in (0x01, 0x80, 0xFF, 0x5A):
        await h.drive(valid=1, data=b, tag="CRC-INIT pre")
    await h.drive(init=1, valid=1, data=0xC3, tag="CRC-INIT with valid")
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "init with valid did not win"
    await h.drive(valid=1, data=0x42, tag="CRC-INIT post")
    await h.drive(init=1, valid=0, data=0x99, tag="CRC-INIT alone")
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "CRC-EMPTY after init"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=500, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_every_single_byte(dut):
    """CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER: each of the 256 single-byte frames."""
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    for b in range(256):
        await h.frame([b], tag=f"CRC-POLY byte 0x{b:02x}")
        assert int(dut.crc.value) == model_crc_of([b])


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=200, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_bit_order(dut):
    """CRC-ORDER: a byte and its bit-reverse give different results, and each
    matches the non-reflected model."""
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    pairs = [(0x01, 0x80), (0x03, 0xC0), (0x0F, 0xF0), (0x12, 0x48)]
    for a, rev in pairs:
        assert model_crc_of([a]) != model_crc_of([rev])
        await h.frame([a], tag="CRC-ORDER")
        got_a = int(dut.crc.value)
        await h.frame([rev], tag="CRC-ORDER rev")
        got_rev = int(dut.crc.value)
        assert got_a != got_rev, f"0x{a:02x} and 0x{rev:02x} gave the same crc"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=200, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_hold(dut):
    """CRC-HOLD: with valid and init low the value holds over many edges,
    whatever data holds."""
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    await h.frame([0xDE, 0xAD], tag="CRC-HOLD setup")
    held = int(dut.crc.value)
    for d in (0x00, 0xFF, 0x55, 0xAA, 0x01):
        await h.drive(valid=0, data=d, tag="CRC-HOLD")
        assert int(dut.crc.value) == held, "value changed with valid low"
    await h.drive(valid=1, data=0xBE, tag="CRC-HOLD resume")
    await h.drive(valid=0, data=0x00, tag="CRC-HOLD gap")
    await h.drive(valid=1, data=0xEF, tag="CRC-HOLD resume")
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == model_crc_of([0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF])


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=200, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_multi_byte_frames(dut):
    """CRC-POLY over frames; the frame result is independent of gaps."""
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    frames = [
        [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00],
        [0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF],
        list(b"123456789"),
        [0x80, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01],
        list(range(32)),
    ]
    for f in frames:
        await h.frame(f, tag="CRC-POLY frame")
        assert int(dut.crc.value) == model_crc_of(f)
        # appending the inverted running value yields a fixed residue in the
        # model; check the DUT agrees on that extended frame too
        ext = f + [int(dut.crc.value)]
        await h.frame(ext, tag="CRC-POLY extended")
        assert int(dut.crc.value) == model_crc_of(ext)


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=2000, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_random(dut):
    """Seeded random traffic with valid gaps, mid-frame init and reset, and
    init/reset offered at the same edge as valid. Fails if any corner was
    never reached."""
    seed = random.getrandbits(32)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    dut._log.info("test_random seed %d", seed)
    h = Harness(dut)
    await h.start()
    await h.reset()
    corners = {"init_with_valid": 0, "reset_with_valid": 0,
               "hold": 0, "byte": 0, "init_mid_frame": 0}
    for _ in range(3000):
        rst_n = 0 if rng.random() < 0.03 else 1
        init = 1 if rng.random() < 0.08 else 0
        valid = 1 if rng.random() < 0.7 else 0
        data = rng.randrange(256)
        if not rst_n and valid:
            corners["reset_with_valid"] += 1
        elif rst_n and init and valid:
            corners["init_with_valid"] += 1
        elif rst_n and init and h.model.running != START:
            corners["init_mid_frame"] += 1
        elif rst_n and not init and not valid:
            corners["hold"] += 1
        elif rst_n and not init and valid:
            corners["byte"] += 1
        await h.drive(rst_n=rst_n, init=init, valid=valid, data=data,
                      tag=f"random seed={seed}")
    dut._log.info("corners reached: %s, checks: %d", corners, h.checks)
    for name, count in corners.items():
        assert count > 0, f"corner {name} never reached (seed {seed})"
=== END FILE ===
